data.title: Docebo Inc. Announces Substantial Issuer Bid Price Increase and Extension
data.description: Docebo Inc., a leading Enterprise Platform for the AI-era workforce, has disclosed the adjustment of its substantial issuer bid terms. The company, listed on NASDAQ under DCBO and TSX under DCBO, revealed its intention to repurchase up to US$70,000,000 worth of its common shares for cancellation from shareholders. The Offer aims to enhance the unification of skills intelligence, learning, and knowledge within the organization. This initiative marks a strategic move by Docebo to streamline its operations and maximize shareholder value.

data.title: Overtime Joins the OH.io Portfolio to Accelerate Demand for Its Voice-First AI Platform for Billing and Collections
data.description: In Columbus, Ohio, Overtime, a developer of a voice-first AI platform specializing in billing, collections, and debt recovery, has revealed a new partnership with OH.io, a local performance venture. This collaboration focuses on accelerating their entry into the market. As part of the agreement, Overtime becomes part of the OH.io portfolio and gains access to a specialized team of go-to-market experts. This dedicated team will assist Overtime in boosting their demand generation efforts, including a focused inside-sales unit and an account-based marketing initiative designed to drive the company's sales activities.

data.description: In the latest report, it was stated that the number of new COVID-19 cases has reached 10,000, with hospitalizations rising by 15%. Additionally, the death toll has now surpassed 500, marking a significant increase in fatalities. Vaccination efforts continue, with over 40% of the population now fully vaccinated. Despite these efforts, there are concerns about the emergence of new variants and the potential impact on the effectiveness of existing vaccines. Authorities are closely monitoring the situation and urging the public to remain vigilant in the face of the ongoing pandemic.

data.title: 63% of Americans find Trump family's crypto profits inappropriate; 50% of Republicans feel his business interests influence decisions.
data.description: In a recent survey conducted by Reuters/Ipsos, it was revealed that a significant majority, or 63%, of Americans believe that the Trump family's gains from cryptocurrency are not appropriate. Furthermore, the survey indicated that half of the president's own party members, the Republicans, feel that his financial interests have an influence on his decision-making.

data.title: Gulf & Pacific Equities Corp. reports on 2026 Semi-Annual Results with Revenue of $2,356,856
data.description: In Toronto on August 21, 2026, Gulf & Pacific Equities Corp. (TSX-V: GUF) announced a 4.4% rise in revenue to $2,356,856 for the six months concluding on June 30, 2026, compared to $2,257,363 in the corresponding period in the previous year. The company specializes in acquiring, managing, and developing anchored shopping centers in Western Canada.

data.title: Arbutus Announces Intent to Repurchase Up to US$230 Million of its Common Shares Through Modified “Dutch Auction” Tender Offer
data.description: Arbutus Biopharma Corporation, a biopharmaceutical company specializing in infectious disease, has announced their intention to launch a modified “Dutch Auction” tender offer. The offer aims to buy back up to $230 million of the company's common shares at a price ranging between $5.00 and $5.75 per share in cash, excluding withholding taxes and interest. This initiative is scheduled to begin around August 24, 2026, and is set to end on or around September 29, 2026, unless extended or canceled by Arbutus. The funding for this buyback is anticipated to come from the company's existing cash reserves.

data.title: Enigmatig Reports First Half Fiscal 2026 Results Following Transition to Cost-Plus Billing Model
data.description: In Singapore on August 21, 2026, Enigmatig Limited (NYSE American: EGG), a company facilitating global business expansions, disclosed its unaudited financial performance for the initial half of fiscal year 2026, concluding on March 31, 2026, on August 7, 2026.

data.title: Foresight Evaluates Expansion into New Technology Markets, Including AI-Based Technologies, Cybersecurity and Data Centers
data.description: A company is currently evaluating various growth prospects, such as the potential purchase of AI-based technologies, cybersecurity firms, or data centers, alongside sustaining its current business operations. The aim is to explore diversification and expansion within the market. This strategic move involves examining opportunities that align with the company's capabilities and objectives. It is a part of the company's plan to enhance its market presence and stay competitive. The company is actively considering potential acquisitions or partnerships in these sectors to capitalize on their growth potential. This initiative demonstrates the company's commitment to adapting to the evolving business landscape and seizing new opportunities for development.

data.title: Professional Diversity Network Launches PDN Intelligence to Advance GPU-Powered AI Infrastructure
data.description: Today, in Chicago, Professional Diversity Network, Inc. (Nasdaq: IPDN) declared the establishment of PDN Intelligence, Inc. a wholly owned subsidiary, to drive their venture into artificial intelligence infrastructure and GPU-powered computing. The company, functioning as a technology holding firm, focuses on workforce solutions, remote talent, and artificial intelligence. PDN Intelligence will spearhead the company's expansion.

data.title: Havila Shipping ASA: Contract extension with Equinor Energy for Havila Troll
data.description: Equinor Energy has decided to extend their contract for the Havila Troll vessel for an additional year, now keeping it in their fleet until November 2027. This decision includes 2 more optional extensions, each for a year.
